summary: Complete e2e testing of PGSaathi v2 - all new backend routes (notifications, notices, housekeeping, users, tenant_portal) tested along with existing features. All 66 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend pages verified - all new pages load correctly with proper role-based navigation.

minor.issue: FastAPI returns 403 instead of 401 for missing auth token (semantic issue only, functionality correct)

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown stays open and can intercept clicks on elements below header. Clicking elsewhere closes it but requires manual close.
Check-In Date field uses browser native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy format) instead of ShadCN calendar component

issues: Quick Actions widget items (Add Tenant, Create Invoice, Complaints, Properties) remain in English when Hindi is selected - missing translation keys
Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility enhancement recommended

action_items: LOW: Add Hindi translations for Quick Actions widget keys on Dashboard
LOW: Replace native date picker in tenant/housekeeping forms with ShadCN calendar component
LOW: Add aria-describedby to Dialog components for accessibility compliance
critical_code_review_comments: All new backend routes working correctly: /notifications, /notices, /housekeeping, /users, /tenant-portal
Bulk invoice generation (/api/invoices/bulk) correctly skips existing invoices for same period
Prorated rent calculation (/api/invoices/prorate) correctly handles partial month stays
PDF invoice generation (/api/invoices/{id}/pdf) working with proper content-type header
Password reset (/api/auth/reset-password) and password change (/api/users/me/password) both functional
Tenant lifecycle complete: create with room assignment -> KYC verify/reject -> switch bed -> checkout
Role-based access control working: owner sees all nav items, users endpoint restricted to owners
Tenant portal endpoints (/tenant-portal/*) return proper data structure even for non-tenant users

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all pages load, all nav items visible, dialogs functional)
